entities.summary: Gilson Cardoso Fahur, better known as Sargento Fahur , is a retired military police officer from the State of Paraná and a Brazilian politician, affiliated with the Liberal Party (PL) and a former member of the ROTAM of the 4th Company of the Paraná State Highway Police (PRE).
